introH2: 🏭 What types of stays are there near Amata City Chonburi, and how do you pick the right one for work?
introHtml: The Pluak Daeng-Bo Win area, on the border of Chonburi and Rayong, is the heart of the Eastern Seaboard industrial zone, where Amata City Rayong, Eastern Seaboard, WHA, and Siam Eastern are all clustered together — and the stays around here come in more flavors than most people expect. Some are 4-star hotels with two saltwater pools to soak in after work and breakfast that draws praise. Some are serviced apartments with a small in-room kitchen, bookable by the night or by the month. And some are studios starting in the low hundreds that focus on being clean, quiet, and easy to park at. Plenty of people who come to work or train in the industrial estates book the wrong type and end up with a room far from the factory, or with facilities that don't suit a long stay. This article rounds up 10 stays near Amata City Chonburi-Rayong that we've reviewed in depth, across Pluak Daeng, Mab Yang Phon, and Bo Win — every one drawn from reading guests' real reviews, telling you the good and the caveats honestly, with a 3-site price compare and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: The Amata City area has no train line or dense public transport. A location like this works best when you have your own car or a company shuttle · Most stays in this article are a few minutes' drive from the estate gates · The main neighborhoods in this article: Pluak Daeng · Mab Yang Phon — clustered near Amata City Rayong and the Eastern Seaboard, with made-to-order eateries and convenience stores around · Bo Win · Si Racha — near Siam Eastern and Hemaraj, with Robinson Bo Win and Saphan Si market about a 15 min drive away · Most have free parking, and many have an in-house eatery or convenience store, which helps on nights when heading out isn't convenient · Pattaya beach is about a 30–50 min drive, handy for a weekend trip.

entries.name: The Contrast i Hotel
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.5 · 355 reviews · TripAdvisor #1 in Pluak Daeng

entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pluak Daeng · a few min drive to Amata-WHA
entries.addr: 955/100 Moo 4, Pluak Daeng Subdistrict, Pluak Daeng, Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Among the stays near Amata City that we've reviewed, if you had to pick the single most complete one, many reviews give it to The Contrast i Hotel — a 4-star, family-run hotel open since 2016, in Pluak Daeng Subdistrict on the Chonburi-Rayong border, a few minutes' drive from Amata City Rayong and the WHA Eastern Seaboard industrial zone. It has the highest star rating and the score backed by the most reviews in this article, at 8.5 from 355 reviews on Trip.com, and TripAdvisor also ranks it #1 among hotels in Pluak Daeng district · What gets industrial-estate workers talking is the two outdoor saltwater pools with a sun terrace for an easing soak after work, plus a fitness room, spa, massage room, pool table, and karaoke, so there's something to do at the hotel in the evening without going far · There are 238 rooms split across Building A and B, from the Standard King at around 30–36 sq.m. up to the Super Superior King at around 45–48 sq.m. that many reviews call larger than the price suggests, and the Super Superior Plus with an in-room bathtub · The thing praised most of all is the buffet breakfast — one foreign review went so far as to call it the best hotel breakfast buffet they'd had in Thailand, with Asian, halal, and vegetarian options that suit the many nationalities working in the estate · Honest caveats from the reviews: soundproofing between rooms isn't great, you sometimes hear the next room or the corridor; the Wi-Fi signal is weak in some rooms; and the surrounding area has no shops within walking distance, so it suits people with their own car best · This is the most well-rounded pick for anyone coming to work, train, or run errands in the estate area who wants a comfortable base with good food and a pool to unwind at, at a price you can keep in check.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're a light sleeper, request a corner room or one not next to the corridor at booking, since soundproofing isn't a strong point · If a bathtub matters to you, choose the Super Superior Plus and specify it clearly · For a long work stay, ask the hotel directly about weekly or monthly rates.
pros: Highest star rating in the article · most complete facilities, 2 saltwater pools, fitness, spa
Praised buffet breakfast with halal and vegetarian options
Rooms larger than the price suggests, especially the 45–48 sq.m. Super Superior
Near Amata-WHA, easy drive to work · warm family-run service
cons: Soundproofing between rooms isn't great, you hear the next room sometimes (from reviews)
Weak Wi-Fi signal in some rooms · no in-house laundry service
Surrounding area has no shops within walking distance, you need your own car

entries.storyHtml: Rangh Place is a serviced apartment and 3-star hotel in the Mab Yang Phon area of Pluak Daeng district that has become one of the popular choices for Amata City Rayong workers, reflected in its 8.3 score and 198 reviews — the second-most in this article after the top-ranked stay · From the real reviews, the consistent praise is for clean, quiet rooms that are easy to sleep in, which suits people who have to get up early for a shift or the factory, about a 15 min drive from AMATA City Rayong · What sets it apart from the usual worker apartments is that it has a garden, mini-golf, and a BBQ grilling area to unwind in the evening, plus an in-house eatery and free private parking, so you come back in the evening to a spot to relax without driving anywhere · There are around 61 rooms, from the Standard Double with a large bed to the Superior Twin for colleagues sharing a room, some with a balcony · The service draws praise for being friendly and especially attentive to long-stay guests, with a 24-hour front desk for late check-in after a shift, and airport transfer and car rental for those without a car · Honest caveats: it's an industrial-estate area where you really need a car, convenience stores and food aren't right next to the property, there's no pool or fitness room like a big hotel, the decor is plain and function-first rather than pretty, and some rates are non-refundable so read the conditions before booking · In short, it's a good-value, balanced pick for industrial-estate workers who want a clean, quiet room with a garden spot to relax in, in the low hundreds.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a weekly or monthly stay, contact the property directly to ask for a special rate, which is usually cheaper than booking nightly · Read the rate conditions carefully because some are non-refundable · If you don't have a car, ask about the property's airport transfer and car rental in advance.
pros: Clean, quiet rooms, easy to sleep in, good for early risers heading to work
Has a garden, mini-golf, and a BBQ grilling corner to unwind
About 15 min from AMATA City Rayong · free private parking
Friendly staff, good with long-stay guests · 24-hour front desk
cons: Industrial-estate location, you need a car, food isn't right next to the property
No pool or fitness room like a big hotel

entries.storyHtml: If you measure purely by score, I-Home Residence and Hotel is the highest-rated in this article at 8.9 from 84 reviews on Trip.com · It's a residence and hotel with around 60 rooms in the Pluak Daeng area, on Soi Mab Yang Phon 25 on the Chonburi-Rayong border, sitting right in the middle of the eastern industrial zone, a few minutes' drive from the Amata City Rayong, Eastern Seaboard, and Pinthong estate cluster · What reviews consistently mention, and the reason the score is high, is the cleanliness of the rooms, AC that really gets cold, and the quiet that lets you sleep fully — the three things industrial-estate workers care about most when they have to get up early to tackle work · There are several room types, from the Standard Queen and Standard Triple at around 22 sq.m. to the Premier King at around 44 sq.m.; every room has AC, a fridge, a work desk, satellite TV, and many have a balcony · A lifesaver for workers is the in-house eatery and convenience store, so at night after work you don't have to drive far, plus a fitness room, garden, terrace, free parking, and 24-hour security that guests parking overnight rate highly · It takes both nightly and monthly stays, with monthly rates starting around 5,000 baht, very good value for people on a project for several months · Honest caveats: some rooms don't have a hairdryer or kettle, so ask before booking; there's no pool for those who want a resort-style break; and the Pluak Daeng location is car-dependent · It suits engineers, employees, and contractors who want a clean, quiet room, a full night's sleep, and value for every baht best.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you need a hairdryer or kettle, specify or ask at booking and bring your own just in case · For a long stay, ask about the monthly rate (from around 5,000 baht) and check the room is a serviced-apartment type · When calling a ride, give the address as Soi Mab Yang Phon 25 so you don't get lost.
pros: Highest score in the article at 8.9 · very clean rooms, cold AC, quiet, easy to sleep
Has an in-house eatery and convenience store, no driving far at night
Near Amata City and Eastern Seaboard, quick drive to the factory
Free parking, 24-hr security · nightly and monthly stays

No pool for those who want a resort-style break

entries.storyHtml: Grand Esie Service Apartment is the lightest-priced pick in this article, starting at just around ฿500/night, yet it scores an overall 8.2 from 62 reviews, and what's interesting is that its service category scores as high as 9.4, unexpectedly high for a 2-star apartment · It's a serviced apartment in the Mab Yang Phon area of Pluak Daeng district, right in the middle of the estate zone, an easy drive to the Amata City and Eastern Seaboard estates, near ESIE Plaza, Saphan 4 market, and convenience stores · From the real reviews, the most-praised thing is the lovely, helpful, friendly staff and the 24-hour front desk that makes late check-in after a shift easy, plus rooms that are clean with no musty smell and larger than expected at this price · There are around 78 rooms, from the Standard Interior View with a single bed to the Deluxe Twin with an outside-facing view; every room has AC, a fridge, a TV, and a balcony · It takes both nightly and monthly stays, with a monthly rate that's good value for industrial-estate workers who need to stay long · Honest caveats: there's no pool, the facilities are fairly basic, the building has been open since 2007 and parts are showing their age, breakfast costs extra on top of the room rate, and public transport is limited in an industrial area, so it's easiest with a car · It suits people who need to work at the Pluak Daeng-Mab Yang Phon estates and want a clean room close to work on the tightest budget, both nightly and monthly.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a long stay, ask about the monthly rate directly (call 090-974-8598); the per-night average is much cheaper than nightly · For an outside-facing view, choose the Deluxe Twin (Old Port View) · Breakfast is charged separately; if you don't need it, eating out or self-catering is cheaper.

entries.storyHtml: i Boutique Hotel is a 3-star boutique hotel in the Mab Yang Phon area of Pluak Daeng district that sets itself apart from the usual worker apartments with boutique-style decor and rooms larger than the price, scoring 8.1 from 86 reviews · It's near Amata City Rayong, an easy drive to work, and suits industrial-estate workers, long-stay guests, and people driving through who want a good-value overnight stop · What the real reviews consistently mention is rooms that are larger and cleaner than what you pay, comfortable beds, and a quiet atmosphere that's easy to sleep in, especially the Deluxe King and Deluxe Twin at around 37 sq.m. with a balcony and a work desk, good for staying several nights · There are around 84-94 rooms, from the Standard Double to the Grand Deluxe / Suite for families or long stays · Another point that draws praise is the food in the restaurant — inexpensive but tasty — and a praised breakfast, plus staff who are good and friendly, and free parking that's convenient for those driving themselves · Honest caveats: the building has been open since 2016, some of the decor is starting to age and a few corners feel dim, there's no pool for those who want a resort-style break, the Wi-Fi has conditions or an extra charge on some packages, and the estate area around it has no eateries or shops within walking distance, so it's easiest to get around with your own car · It suits people who want to stay near Amata City on an affordable budget but get a spacious room and a boutique feel that looks better than a typical apartment.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a spacious room with a balcony, choose the Deluxe King or Deluxe Twin at around 37 sq.m. — only a little more than the Standard · Check the Wi-Fi conditions on the package you book, since some have an extra charge · If light matters to you, avoid the corner rooms that reviews call dim.

entries.storyHtml: Interpark Residence and Serviced Apartment Chonburi-Rayong is a 4-star serviced apartment positioned right at the entrance to the Eastern Seaboard industrial estate in Pluak Daeng district on the Chonburi-Rayong border, and within easy reach of the Amata City estate · It scores 7.3 from 204 reviews on Trip.com (the second-most reviews after the article's top ranks), and TripAdvisor 4.4 out of 5 holds it at #1 among Specialty Lodging in Pluak Daeng · What sets it apart from a regular hotel is that every room is a full serviced apartment, with a small kitchen, microwave, fridge, and a private balcony, genuinely suited to long stays — easy to cook something simple, store fresh food, or reheat a meal · There are around 76 rooms, from the Standard Twin at around 32 sq.m. to the Superior King at around 36 sq.m. and a room with a bathtub for an easing soak · For an estate-area stay, the common areas are better than many places nearby, with a outdoor pool, mineral bath/jacuzzi, fitness room, massage room, and a meeting/seminar room for company groups that need to run training · The price highlight is the monthly booking option, where the per-night cost drops a lot compared with nightly, good for people staying several months · Honest caveats: the cleaning is inconsistent some days with amenities not topped up, some rooms have no safe or phone, the balcony has no furniture, the AC in some rooms blows straight onto the bed, you get one key per room, and parts of the mineral bath may carry an extra charge, so ask at the front desk first · It suits engineers, company employees, and businesspeople who need to stay near clients in the estate and want a room with a kitchen on a budget they can keep in check best.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a long stay, ask about the monthly rate directly, since it's much cheaper than booking nightly and comes fully furnished with no long lease like a condo · If two people are staying, request an extra key/keycard at check-in · Check the room has a safe/phone if you need them, and ask about the mineral-bath charge at the front desk before using it.

entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The resort is deep down Soi Mab Yang Phon 28, away from the main road, so open the map and the exact coordinates before driving over; if you don't have a car, plan a ride-hailing app and your meals ahead · Test the AC at check-in, since there are reviews about it being slow to cool · If you need the pool/fitness, confirm with the property before booking.

faqTitle: FAQ — Frequently asked questions about stays near Amata City Chonburi

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best stay near Amata City Chonburi?
faq.a: It depends on your budget and use · If you measure by complete facilities and a pool to soak in, The Contrast i Hotel, a 4-star hotel with 2 saltwater pools scoring 8.5 from 355 reviews, is the most well-rounded pick · If you measure purely by review score, I-Home Residence and Hotel scores 8.9, the highest in the article, with clean, quiet rooms · For the tightest budget, Grand Esie and Thana Apartment start at around ฿500 · For a long stay with a room with a kitchen, Interpark Residence and Room 9 Residence suit best

faq.q: ❓ How much do stays near Amata City cost?
faq.a: In this article, prices start at approximately ฿500–1,500 per night · The cheapest are Grand Esie and Thana Apartment from ฿500, followed by Prew Lom Chom Nam and Rangh Place from ฿650, and I-Home from ฿680 · The full-hotel tier is The Contrast i Hotel and Interpark Residence from ฿1,500 · Many stays have weekly or monthly rates that are much better value for industrial-estate workers who need to stay long, so ask the property directly

faq.q: ❓ Which stays near Amata City have a pool?
faq.a: In this article, the stays with a pool are The Contrast i Hotel (2 outdoor saltwater pools), Interpark Residence (pool + mineral bath/jacuzzi), and Prew Lom Chom Nam Resort (pool in the garden) · As for Arcadia Resort, the pool information differs across platforms, so confirm with the property before booking · Most of the remaining residence and apartment types have no pool, focusing instead on clean rooms and a location near the estate

faq.q: ❓ Can you stay in the Amata City area without your own car?
faq.a: Yes, but you need to plan, because the Amata City-Pluak Daeng-Bo Win area has inconvenient public transport, and almost every trip needs a car · The options are using a ride-hailing app (Grab), asking about the property's shuttle, or coordinating a company shuttle if you're working in the estate · Some places like Room 9 Residence have estate shuttles passing in front, and Rangh Place has airport transfer and car rental · For a stay deep down a soi like Arcadia Resort, plan your travel and meals ahead

faq.q: ❓ Is this area in Chonburi or Rayong province?
faq.a: This area is the border between Chonburi and Rayong · Amata City Rayong and the Eastern Seaboard estate straddle the two provinces; many stays in the article are in Pluak Daeng district, Rayong province (such as The Contrast i, I-Home, Interpark, Grand Esie, i Boutique), while Prew Lom Chom Nam, Arcadia, and Thana are on the Bo Win-Khao Khansong side, Si Racha district, Chonburi province · But all of them share the Amata City and Eastern Seaboard estates and are an easy drive from one another, so they're grouped in one set

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book a stay in the Amata City area?
faq.a: Many stays in this area are small properties (some around 12–40 rooms) with regular monthly guests, so they fill up fast · When the estates have training, seminars, or major events, prices tend to rise and availability is low, so book ahead, especially Room 9 Residence where nightly rooms are limited · In normal periods, booking a few days ahead is enough · Every platform usually has Free Cancellation; we recommend locking in a rate like that if your plans aren't settled, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
